services.desc: We are open every day for experienced jumping provided the weather will allow us to jump. Whether you like RW, freeflying, CRW,or accuracy, we have it all at Skydive Greene County. We have many jumpers who have been around for awhile and some new faces as well this year-we would love to have you be one of those! We have a main landing area of over 5 acres and an additional 10 acres as a secondary with hundreds of acres for safe outs if you do happen to land off the airport. Please ask to receive a complete area briefing if you are new to the dropzone area. Our office/Clubhouse building is the center of our DZ.
